note: The branding contract (fe-country-split-plan §4.4): per application, every key a country may brand and every file it may ship, each with the path in the country's <app>/assets/ folder and the build's output path. `{lang}` is a UI language of the application, `{doc}` a legal document. A key's kind says what its value is: `text` plain text, `html` text the application renders as HTML (its markup held to the country's reference branding), `url` an https: URL, `file` the output path of a brandable file the country ships. A required key is in every UI language's branding; a key that `requires` others is set only with them, in each language that sets it, and a key that `recommends` others is warned of when set without them; a required file is shipped (the base product's own build stages its default copy, so no page links a file it lacks). The `country.` key namespace is the country's own. The Niord mark and the administration app's favicon are the base product's and not brandable. A file's `width` and `height` are its pixel size, read from a PNG's header (IHDR); a size the schema leaves out is free. A key that `forbids` a rule holds nothing that rule, named in lib/branding.mjs, finds: `year` a year written in, `address` an address written in or {{url}} outside an href. A legal document's `labelKey` is the footer's label that offers it: a label is set only with the document's `titleKey` and with the document shipped in some branding language, and a shipped document without its label is warned of; a legal section whose `labelCheck` is `warning` belongs to a footer a country may replace with its own (the public site's default footer), so there a label without its title or document is warned of, not failed. A legal document that `namesPreferences` names each key the public site stores in a reader's browser, with its prefix, as ui-apps/info/src/app/core/services/preference-keys.json lists them.

footer.copyright.description: The footer's copyright line; the footer shows it only when set.

footer.disclaimer.description: The footer's label for the disclaimer; the footer offers the document only when set.

footer.cookies.description: The footer's label for the cookie policy; the footer offers the document only when set.

footer.accessibility.description: The footer's label for the link to the administration app's accessibility statement; the footer shows it only when set, with its address.

footer.accessibilityLink.description: The address of the administration app's own accessibility statement (its own statement, not the public site's), which the footer label links.

main.footer.links.center.url.description: Where the footer's logo links; set with the link's accessible name.

main.footer.links.center.imageSrc.description: The footer's logo, one of the files below; the footer shows it only when set, with its alternative text.

branding/company-logo-{lang}.png.description: The authority's logo in the footer, per language.

MAP_ACCESSIBILITY.description: The map's link to the accessibility statement, whose address the product fills into {{url}}, the link's href, from info.config.ts; the value writes no address of its own.

FOOTER_COPYRIGHT.description: The footer's copyright line, over the English pack's neutral one; the product fills {{year}} with the deployment's own year, so the value writes none.

FOOTER_DISCLAIMER.description: The country footer's label for the disclaimer.

FOOTER_COOKIES.description: The country footer's label for the cookie policy.

FOOTER_ACCESSIBILITY.description: The country footer's label for the accessibility statement.

FOOTER_LOGO.description: The country footer's logo, one of the files below; set it with its alternative text.

branding/favicon.png.description: The favicon, 32×32 px, which index.html links.

branding/apple-touch-icon.png.description: The touch icon, 152×152 px, which index.html links.

branding/logo-gray.png.description: The country footer's logo, 44 px high, twice the 22 px the footer draws; its width is free.

branding/logo-gray-{lang}.png.description: The country footer's logo, per language, 44 px high, twice the 22 px the footer draws; its width is free.
